result.rationale: The diff removes the embed_category setting and changes TopicEmbed.import to use `category: eh.try(:category_id)` where `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)`. For feed-polled topics (feed_polling_url), the URL need not match any EmbeddableHost row, so `eh` is nil and the imported topic loses the previously configured category — while the setting that governed this was deleted in the same PR (site_settings.yml and locales removed embed_category). The mechanism is directly visible in the diff; severity/impact on feed polling is plausible but partially dependent on external behavior.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the global `embed_category` setting (deleted from `config/site_settings.yml` and `server.en.yml`) and changes `TopicEmbed.import` to choose the category via `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). There is no fallback to the prior global category when no `EmbeddableHost` row matches the imported URL’s host, so imports can now create topics without the previously configured category. The migration only backfills `embeddable_hosts` rows from the old `embeddable_hosts` setting and then deletes both settings, so cases where imports occur without a corresponding host row are not covered.
